summary: A story about NASA "astronaut" James Brown being lost in the red desert after a faulty landing. The story tells his journey surviving on Mars in a shelter surrounded by rovers instead of people. The rovers are introduced as human like beings instead of just machines. This project was meant to be a childrens book that kids can read to become more interested in topics like space, rovers and NASA while also reading a fun and exciting book. We put a lot of work into this project. We hope you enjoy it while reading :)
details: A exciting story about NASA "astronaut" James Brown being lost in the red desert. He survives on the planet until one day he receives a message that changes his life. In this project I think we did the objective in a really creative way. All of our team members contributed into making this project. The plot twist at the end of the story makes this a creative work. The team wanted to make this as plausible and non-fiction as possible. We paid a lot of detail to all the information and images. For the past 2 days we have put all our passion into this project, so we hope you enjoy :)
